text:
Priya: Heads-up — Orbit QBR scheduled next Wed 3pm PT. Need final slide owners, current renewal risk status, and 1–2 exec asks. Can ppl drop updates here by EOD Fri?

Leo: I can own the performance slide (latency/cost metrics). Will pull last 90d token cost and top routes.

Tom: I'll take the integration/enablement slide — will include onboarding % complete and remaining blockers (mostly logs + SSO).

Aisha: I'll prep the exec ask slide. Quick ask idea: exec cover to approve 3-month pilot for dedicated capacity to hit Q3 SLA targets. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam: Renewal risk for Orbit currently YELLOW. Health signals: usage up 12% but feature adoption (embeddings) lagging; one trial customer reported dataset connection flakiness. Logged support ticket #4231.

Priya: Good — Sam can you paste the short risk blurb we can put on the risk slide? Keep to 2 sentences.

Sam: "Renewal risk: YELLOW — adoption momentum but critical infra flakiness for dataset connector impacts demo fidelity. Mitigation: ops triage in progress; propose canary Dedicated pool for high-value accounts."

Leo: FYI I'll include the per-route token trend chart. If anyone wants specific routes highlighted, ping me.

Tom: For onboarding status — current cohort (6 customers): 4 finished, 1 blocked on SSO, 1 blocked on data mapping. ETA for both blockers = 2 weeks with SE support. I'll add a mini timeline.

Aisha: Exec ask wording: "Approve pilot procurement for dedicated capacity ($X/mo) to stabilize high-value accounts and reduce demo flakiness; authorize SE hours for rapid SSO/data-map fixes." Keep short.

Priya: Great. Two admin asks: (1) slide ownership doc link -> https://drive.redwood/Orbit-QBR (please add your slide by Mon noon); (2) dry run Tue 11am PT. reminder-bot will post calendar invite. :calendar:

reminder-bot: Created calendar event: Orbit QBR dry run — Tue 11:00 PT. Invitees: Priya, Leo, Tom, Aisha, Sam.

Leo: Quick question — do we want a fallback model/variant to call out if dedicated pilot isn't approved? Could add a cost/loss scenario.

Aisha: Yes add a fallback row: hosted fallback (quantized) + customer-facing mitigation. Keep the slide to 1x table.

Sam: I'll draft the customer quotes/feedback snippet for the health slide — 1 positive, 1 pain point.

Priya: Timeline recap: updates in Drive by Mon noon; dry run Tue 11am PT; final deck to exec by Wed 9am PT. Thanks everyone — tagging for visibility @channel :thumbsup:

Tom: Added initial slide stub to Drive.

Leo: Added charts and highlighted routes "generate_text" and "embed_search".

Sam: Posted support ticket summary and mitigation plan link in the drive doc.

Aisha: Drafted exec ask slide; included cost delta + expected impact.

Priya: Perfect. If any blockers, DM me.
